parts.text:
Meiosis and cytokinesis occur in the male reproductive organs (anthers) of plants to make pollen grains. Cells which carry out meiosis are known as pollen mother cells.

Fig. 2.1 shows five stages of meiosis in a pollen mother cell.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Maize plants have male and female reproductive organs on the same plant. The male anthers are located on structures known as tassels. When selective breeding is carried out to create an $F_1$ hybrid, the tassels are removed.

Suggest why the tassels are removed when selective breeding is carried out to create an $F_1$ hybrid.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Outline how selective breeding is used to produce vigorous, uniform varieties of maize.
